tasks.title: Replace emoji icons with lucide-react icons and add theme toggle tests
tasks.description: 1. WHAT: Replace the emoji-based theme toggle icons (🌙 / ☀️) in Calculator.tsx with lucide-react Moon and Sun SVG components, add lucide-react as a dependency, and write tests that verify the correct icon renders per theme. 2. READ FIRST: src/components/Calculator.tsx (line 123 — current emoji rendering `{theme === 'light' ? '🌙' : '☀️'}`), src/App.tsx (ThemeContext export for test imports), src/components/Calculator.test.tsx (existing describe/it/beforeEach/userEvent pattern to follow). 3. FILES: (a) package.json — add `"lucide-react": "^0.400.0"` (or latest stable) to dependencies. (b) src/components/Calculator.tsx — import `{ Moon, Sun }` from 'lucide-react'; replace the emoji expression on line 123 with `{theme === 'light' ? <Moon size={18} aria-hidden="true" /> : <Sun size={18} aria-hidden="true" />}`. (c) src/components/Calculator.test.tsx — add a new `describe('theme toggle icons')` block inside the top-level `describe('Calculator')`. 4. APPROACH: For the tests, wrap <Calculator /> in a `<ThemeContext.Provider value={{ theme: 'light', toggleTheme: mockFn }}>` to control the theme context. Since lucide icons render as SVG, query the toggle button with `screen.getByRole('button', { name: 'Toggle theme' })` (it already has aria-label='Toggle theme'). Assert the SVG is present inside the button using `button.querySelector('svg')`. Test three cases: (a) light mode renders an SVG inside the toggle button, (b) dark mode renders an SVG inside the toggle button, (c) clicking the toggle button calls toggleTheme. Use `vi.fn()` for the toggleTheme mock. Import ThemeContext from '../App'. Run `npm install` after updating package.json. 5. PATTERNS: Follow the exact same describe/it/beforeEach/userEvent.setup() pattern used in the existing Calculator.test.tsx. The ThemeContext import is already used in Calculator.tsx — follow that same import for tests.
